entries: {first} jacked into {landmark} with {the_thing:portable} and the countdown running.
{first} broadcast {the_message} from {landmark} {MANNER} to every ship in range.
{the_someone} took control of {landmark}, and {first} answered with {the_thing:portable} {MANNER}.
{first} uploaded {the_thing:portable} at {landmark} {MANNER} and waited for the reply.
{first} faced the {rival} in {landmark}, holding {the_thing:portable} and the last of {VALUE}.
{the_someone} asked {first} at {landmark} what makes a human, and {first} answered {MOTIVE}.
{first} crossed the outer hull to {landmark} {MANNER} with {THING:portable} and minutes of air.
{SOMEONE:!plural} shut itself down at {landmark} {MANNER}, by choice.
